spans.s:
mfn. (-च्छः-च्छा-च्छं)
Clear, transparent.
m. (-च्छः)
1 A bear.
2 Crystal.
ind.
Fronting, before, in presence of.
E.
अ neg. or comparative, and च्छो to cut, aff. ड.

r. 1st cl. (इ.) आच्छि (आञ्छति)
To lengthen or stretch.

m. (-ल्लः)
A bear. This is sometimes considered as two words. See अच्छ and भल्ल.
E.
अच्छ in front of, and भल्ल to kill.

mfn. (-द्यः-द्या-द्यं)
Not to be cut, incapable of injury or comminution.
E.
अ neg. छेद्य to be cut.

mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं)
1

Covered.
2

Clothed.
E.
आङ् before च्छद to cover, affix क्त.

m. (-कः)
A tree, (Morinda tinctoria.)

m. (-दः)
Cloth, clothes.
E.
आङ्, छद to cover, घञ् aff.

n. (-नं)
1 Cloth, clothes.
2 Covering, disappearance.
3 A covering, a sheath, mantle, cloak, &c.
E.
see the last, affix ल्युट्.

Covered.
2

Clothed.
E.
आङ् before छद to cover, affix क्त.

mfn. (-द्यः-द्या-द्यं)
To be covered or clothed.
ind.
Having clothed or put. on.
E.
आङ् before छद to cover, causal form, यत् or ल्यप् affix; also आच्छादनीय and आच्छादितव्य.

mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं)
Cut, cut off.
E.
आङ् before छिद to cut, क्त aff.

n. (-तं)
1 A horse laugh.
2 Making a noise with the finger nails by rubbing them on one another.
E.
आङ्, छुर to cut, क्त affix; also आच्छुरितक.

n. (-कं)
See the preceding.

m. (-दः)
Cutting, cutting off, excision.
E.
आङ् before छिद to cut, घञ् aff.

n. (-नं)
Excision.
E.
आङ्, छिद to cut, ल्युट् aff.

n. (-नं)
Hunting, the chase.
E.
आङ्, चुद to command, with ल्युट् affix, च becomes छ.
